html:
The Burj Khalifa is a skyscraper in Dubai, in the United Arab Emirates. At 828 metres it has been the tallest building in the world since it opened in January 2010.

It was designed by the American firm Skidmore, Owings and Merrill, with Adrian Smith as lead architect. Its Y-shaped plan, which steps back in a spiral as it rises, was partly inspired by a desert flower and helps break up the wind. Construction began in 2004 and was done largely by migrant workers from South Asia, such as workers from Kerala, whose low pay and hard conditions drew criticism.

It was planned as Burj Dubai, the centre of a new downtown district. The 2008 financial crisis hit Dubai hard, and neighbouring Abu Dhabi bailed it out. The tower was renamed at its opening for Abu Dhabi's ruler, Khalifa bin Zayed.

The tower is the symbol of the Gulf's building boom, paid for by oil and trade, and of Dubai's bid to be a global hub, along with Emirates. It took the record from Taipei 101.
sum: The Burj Khalifa is a skyscraper in Dubai, in the United Arab Emirates. At 828 metres it has been the tallest building in the world since it opened in January 2010.
